title: Do Vision-Language Models Have Internal World Models? Towards an Atomic Evaluation

layout.note: Framework loop and its dimension lists take the left third; two radial charts sit side by side at centre and right with a model legend at the top right; four question cards fill the corners (two above, two below) and are tied to the charts by dashed leaders; tint pairs yellow cards with perception and pink cards with prediction.

lesson: Reuse the dimension names of the framework as the sector labels of the result charts and tie tinted example cards to the charts with dashed leaders, so framework, evidence and instances read as one composite. A translucent human band behind model bars shows the gap at a glance.
